main_text.p: Theophraftus appellauit, à re impofitum eft, ita- que argumento libri conuenit vt nihil fupra. Erat namque hoc tanquam exemplar & fpeculum quoddam morum,vbi virtutis & vitij cuiufque expreffæ notæ cernebantur. Itaque titulus hic Ἠθι- κοὶ χαρακτῆρες tantundem ferme valet, ac fi dixiffet Εἰκόνες ἠθῶν (fiue εἰκονισμοί,vt appellat Seneca) hoc eft, Imagines morum: ficut Cicero comicos appellat imaginem vitæ quotidianæ: & magnus Bafilius vitas fanctorum virorum,εἰκόνας ἐμψύχως τῆς χ̄ρ Θεὸν πολι- τείας.Εἰκὼν & χαρακτὴρ atque εἰσοπτρον fæpe eandem vim habent:Quare etiam , quod D. Paulus ad Colofl. dixit, Chriftum effe εἰκόνα τὰ ἀοράτυ Θεῦ, in ea ad Hebræos voce χαρακτὴρ eft expreffum. In libro autem Sapientiæ in eadem fententia vtitur auctor vocibus ἐξοπτρον & εἰκών. Porrò is verus eft cuiuf- que rei χαρακτήρ,ea vera imago, quæ illius naturam optimè exprimit. Ideo Hebræi fapientes naturam vocant טבע , quafi dicas χαρακτῆρα, aut σφραγίδα. nam illis טבע figillum fignificat. Veteres verò quidam qui poft Theophraftum idem argumen- tum tractarunt, μικρὸν παρεκλίνοντες, vt diceret Ari- ftoteles, χαρακτηρισμὸς vocarunt , quos ille χαρα- κτῆρας : quidam longiùs abierunt,& fimilium fcri- ptorum titulos diffimiles (vti fere fieri videas ) funt commenti. Seneca ad Lucilium,epiftola xcvi.Ait vtilem futuram effe defcriptionem cuiufque virtutis.Hac Pofidonius Aetiologiam ( malim Ethologiam, vide Quintilianum. )vocat:quidam χαρακτηρισμὸν appel- lant, signa cuiufque virtutis & vitij ac notas reddèn- tem, quibus inter se similia discriminentur.Hæc res ean- dem vim habet quam pracipere. page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout, per the rules (e.g. "fi" = si, "fupra" = supra, "diffimiles" = dissimiles). Greek is uncertain in places and is not marked with [?]: "χ̄ρ" after εἰκόνας ἐμψύχως τῆς (probably Χριστοῦ or similar abbreviation), "ἐξοπτρον" (probably εἰσοπτρον), "ἀοράτυ" and "Θεῦ" (printed forms), and the accents on Ἠθικοὶ, ἠθῶν, and χαρακτηρισμὸς. Hebrew טבע appears twice as printed. The Greek should be checked against the scan. Printed abbreviations kept as printed: "&", "q;" none on this page. Printed "vitij", "vitae", "pracipere", "pracipit" kept as printed. Large text is set in roman with italic passages. Small mark at bottom right of the page is a stain or digitiser mark, not transcribed.
